newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CLEMENTE CALLS UP STRIKER OLI FOR CZECH QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CLEMENTE CALLS UP STRIKER OLI FOR CZECH QUALIFIER.

text.p: Striker Oli Alvarez of struggling Oviedo was a surprise inclusion in the Spanish squad announced by national coach Javier Clemente on Friday for next week's World Cup qualifying match against the Czech Republic.
Clemente has also turned to Emilio Amavisca, the Real Madrid midfielder who has missed much of the season through injury.
Oli has been chosen ahead of Barcelona's Juan Pizzi, who is carrying an injury and is short of match practice.
Oli's 19 goals have made him second only to Alfonso Perez as the most prolific Spanish striker in the first division this season.
Not surprisingly several big clubs are thought to be following his progress, among them Alfonso's Real Betis.
The squad continues to rely on a backbone of four defenders and two midfielders from Barcelona, with utility player Luis Enrique Martinez returning from suspension.
The game will be played in Valladolid on June 8.
Goalkeepers - Andoni Zubizarreta (Valencia), Santiago Canizares (Real Madrid)
Defenders - Rafael Alkorta (Real Madrid), Sergi Barjuan, Abelardo Fernandez, Albert Ferrer, Miguel Angel Nadal (Barcelona), Roberto Rios (Real Betis)
Midfielders - Emilio Amavisca, Fernando Hierro (Real Madrid), Josep Guardiola, Guillermo Amor (Barcelona), Julen Guerrero (Athletic Bilbao), Javier Manjarin (Deportivo Coruna)
Strikers - Oli Alvarez (Oviedo), Raul Gonzalez (Real Madrid), Alfonso Perez (Real Betis), Kiko Narvaez (Atletico Madrid).
